text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More countries condemn Turkish aggression on Iraq.
- Arab citizens in Iraq stage sit-in at the Turkish embasssy in Baghdad.
- Iraq diverts course of a tributary of Tigris river.
- Iraq and Yemen discuss bilateral relations.
- Arab League secretary-general urges speedy implementation of Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
- Minister of industry receives Chinese delegation.
- UNESCO says it is ready to cooperate with Iraq.
(The above were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and AL-IRAQ)
- Editorial on President Saddam Hussein's decision to offer 50 per cent increase in salaries of civil servants to be deposited in a saving account and withdrawn a year from now.
- Turkish troops commit atrocities in northern Iraq.
